text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap hadn't shown up for training, 
and only finally appeared in the Trainer's 
office around evening...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...No matter what. No matter what... I 
just couldn't give up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A limited-time special: 'Gourmand's 
Challenge! Ultra-Chinese MAX★ Special 
Bowl' is...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's the legendary chukadon from the 
Chinese restaurant in the shopping 
district, only available on the menu at 
very specific times...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I am truly sorry... I will make up for it 
in training after this—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... As expected of Special, to push 
me... to push my stomach to such 
limits...!

...Oguri Cap is reflecting on it too. 
There was nothing else to be done, so I 
told her to rest her stomach today...
